features.name: Composite TUI redesign
acceptance_tests: Overview screen shows collapsible sections and supports group/filter toggles
Tactical screen combines map and spawn list on one screen
Debug screen combines player, target, hex dump, and spawn list
features.notes: Overview now owns selected-character detail and activity-at-a-glance state, Tactical shows live map coordinates with zone-aligned demo data, and the third screen is effectively a debug inspector backed by a passing fmt/clippy/test run.

features.name: Operator TUI polish and navmesh audit
acceptance_tests: Characters screen shows group scope and roster-oriented detail instead of PID-first operator hints
Command bar accepts direct character-name targeting via '<name> /cmd'
Tactical screen retains live raster map lines and waypoint overlays
Map and navmesh gaps are documented with concrete next steps and MQ mesh source links
features.notes: Character-name targeting is now wired into the TUI command bar and Characters screen copy. The audit of MQ mesh loading/path queries is documented in the codebase. All automated checks (fmt, clippy, tests) are passing.

features.name: Tactical map navmesh overlay and viewport controls
acceptance_tests: Tactical map supports explicit auto/local/global viewport modes
Focused Tactical map pane supports pan, zoom, and viewport reset controls
Actual navmesh polygon edges render as a cached Tactical overlay when mesh data is available
features.notes: The Tactical map now caches Detour-derived navmesh edge geometry per zone, renders outer and inner mesh lines over the Brewall vector map, and exposes map-pane controls for manual pan, zoom, view mode cycling, and overlay toggling. No local 'simplify' executable was available in this environment.
